labelingMethod: Manual relevance judgment against the 40 official Company-X Markdown documents. Only documents that directly answer the question are labeled relevant.
limitations: This is a public-fixture retrieval evaluation, not a hidden-test or production-quality claim.

questions.question: 최근 서버 장애 사례와 원인을 알려줘
questions.rationale: DOC-010 is the chronologically latest incident report (2026-02-16) and contains both the incident and root-cause analysis.

questions.question: Product-C1 설치 방법이 궁금해
questions.rationale: DOC-011 is the Product-C1 installation guide and contains system requirements and installation steps.

questions.question: Kubernetes 관련 장애 대응 방법은?
questions.rationale: DOC-007 directly describes a Kubernetes Pod OOM incident, its cause, and corrective actions.

questions.question: 성능 최적화를 위한 DB 튜닝 방법 알려줘
questions.rationale: Both performance-tuning guides have a DB optimization section covering connection pools, indexes, and query caching.

questions.question: 보안 취약점 점검 관련 내용이 있어?
questions.rationale: These five meeting notes explicitly record security-vulnerability assessment findings and follow-up work.

questions.question: 백업 정책은 어떻게 되어 있어?
questions.rationale: The two operations manuals explicitly state automated backup schedules, retention periods, and storage locations.

questions.question: API 인증 방식은 뭐야?
questions.rationale: The two API reference documents contain explicit authentication sections.

questions.question: 고객사 미팅에서 논의된 일정 지연 이슈는?
questions.rationale: These meeting notes explicitly mention delayed milestones/tests or an agreed schedule extension.

questions.question: 클라우드 마이그레이션 제안서 내용 보여줘
questions.rationale: DOC-031 and DOC-032 are proposals whose solution descriptions explicitly concern cloud migration.
